opennyai_summary.final__facts:
2. The petitioners apprehend arrest in connection with Paliganj P.S. Case No. 322 of 2023 dated 14.06.2023 instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
On 03.05.2023, co-accused Saroj Devi & Anju Devi forcibly got the informant married with co-accused Deepak Kumar Pandey.
Kumar Pandey established physical relation with the informant.
It is further submitted that the statement of the victim was not recorded as per her free will rather her signature was forcibly taken by the local police on a paper which is made part of the present First Information Report.
The victim girl (informant) made a written complaint in her own hand writing to the S.H.O., Paliganj on the same day i.e. 14.06.2023 which was not taken on record.
After investigation, the Investigating Officer submitted charge sheet under Sections 9 and 10 of the Child Marriage Prohibition Act, 2006 against the petitioners and named accused persons.
It is further submitted that vide order dated 27.03.2024, the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Patna after perusing the charge sheet, took cognizance under Sections 363, 354,
366, 376 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 6, 17 & 18 of the POCSO Act and Sections 9, 10 &
11 of the Child Marriage Prohibition Act against the petitioners and the named accused persons.

Case No. 322 of 2023 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No.162 of 2023, they shall be released on bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge- VII, cum Special Judge (POCSO Act), Patna, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
